title: On a WordPress site running WooCommerce, the analytics import's progress options (woocommerce_admin_scheduler_*) are housekeeping: a Sync from live never lists them as Tracy's version kept, while real WooCommerce settings are still compared
expect: S1: VolatileRows passes: woocommerce_admin_scheduler_* options are volatile; woocommerce_store_address, woocommerce_currency and woocommerce_admin_notices are not
fence: A sync never reports as a conflict a value no person changed
